prBodyNotes: Pin policy (GH #103): any change to the workspace Cargo.lock must sync benchmarks/argentum/Cargo.lock in the same commit, keeping topcoat/toasty revs identical.

Lockfile maintenance is off: topcoat and toasty are bumped deliberately with cargo update -p, never by a blanket cargo update (AGENTS.md "Renovate PRs"), and the workspace lock stays in lockstep with benchmarks/argentum/Cargo.lock.

packageRules.description: argon2 + password-hash bump as one coupled set (AGENTS.md) — never separately
